title: Cross moment bound by influences
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$, and let $i,j$ be distinct coordinates. The expected product of the two input signs and the two thresholded discrete derivatives of $p$ is at most one half the sum of the influence in coordinate $j$ of the thresholded derivative in coordinate $i$ and the influence in coordinate $i$ of the thresholded derivative in coordinate $j$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$i,j$ are coordinates in the sign cube
